title: ExperimentalData_UV-Vis spectroscopy_GO_temperature_reduction_WP2-4_NASU
description: Measurements were performed under WP2-4, Task 2.4. The aim of this work was to study the reduction of graphene oxide (GO) by laser radiation (λ = 455 nm) under laboratory conditions and in nitrogen atmosphere. UV-Vis transmittance spectra measurements were performed in order to confirm reduction. The data set consists of four columns: the first column contains the wavelength values at which the transmittance measurements of the corresponding samples were performed; columns two through four contain the transmittance values for the initial GO sample and samples reduced under laboratory conditions and in nitrogen atmosphere, respectively. Wavelength column unit in nanometers (nm), transmittance intensities - in percent (%).
